title: Decision-tree depth is invariant under negation
statement: Let $f$ be a Boolean function on $n$ variables, and let $\bar f$ denote its pointwise negation, so that $\bar f(x) = 1 - f(x)$ for every input $x$. Then $f$ and $\bar f$ have the same decision-tree depth: $\operatorname{depth}_{\mathrm{DT}}(\bar f) = \operatorname{depth}_{\mathrm{DT}}(f)$.
hypotheses_covered: f is a Boolean function on n variables
